biotools.summary: Parse GFF and GTF files using C++ classes. The package also provides utilities to read and write GFF3 files. The GFF (General Feature Format) format is a tab-delimited file format for describing genes and other features of DNA, RNA, and protein sequences. GFF files are often used to describe the features of genomes.
